AI & Marketing Concepts

AX (Agent Experience)

Agent Experience is the discipline of designing a brand's site, docs, product feeds, pricing and schema so AI agents, not only human users, can discover, read and act on them accurately.

Explanation

It is framed as the agent-era counterpart to UX, and the concept was articulated through 2025 before going mainstream in marketing and CMO commentary through 2026, including a February 2026 Forbes piece. As AI agents from ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini and Copilot increasingly research and even buy on a consumer's behalf, brands that are hard for an agent to parse risk becoming invisible in agent-mediated discovery and purchase decisions. Note that AX has a separate, unrelated expansion in customer-service tooling, where it refers to the human contact-center agent's own experience; the marketing-relevant sense here is about AI agents, and the two should be distinguished by context.

Usage context / examples

Forbes reported companies adding AX ownership to a Director of Web Strategy role, with a dedicated AX lead hired within 6 to 12 months.

Related terms

GEO, AIO, LLMO, AEO

Turkish definition

Agent Experience (AX), bir markanın site, doküman, ürün akışı, fiyatlandırma ve şema verisini yalnızca insan kullanıcılar için değil AI ajanlarının doğru okuyup işlem yapabilmesi için tasarlama disiplinidir.
